title: Agent instructions for end-to-end shipping
summary: Cursor agents now follow one written workflow: Laragon on the owner machine, a milestone with an epic and sub-issues at the start, and a finish through merge, the change log, and Cloudron deploy.
changes: Make AGENTS.md the source of truth for local development, GitHub issues, release metadata, and Cloudron deploy.
Point the Cursor rules at that file and add a release-and-deploy checklist that uses the repository's real commands.
Assign new issues to apescic-director, and record that Issue Type, Priority, and Effort are set in GitHub when the API cannot.
Keep Recruitment vacancies on RecruitmentRole, and keep app and docs wording in UK English.
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.39 line: documentation and issue-template defaults only, with no application behaviour change.
validation: php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the pull request branch.
Version-pinned release history tests updated by myapes:changelog-prepare.
known_limitations: Issue Type, Priority, Effort, assignee, labels, and milestone still need a person in the GitHub sidebar when the API cannot update them.
The GitHub Release is published by the Cloudron deploy workflow, which needs the existing deployment secrets.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. Documentation and issue-template changes do not alter runtime application behaviour.
